name: ACPEC Mobile Security V1 Modular Spec
context_rule: Always load 00_decisions_invariants.md plus the relevant module(s).

closed_decisions.OPEN-CLIENT-001: V1 target mobile clients <= 5000; res.users per client accepted; controlled provisioning only; no Odoo portal signup.
closed_decisions.OPEN-MANAGER-001: manager_field_validation_enabled defaults to false; manager trusted validation disabled unless explicitly enabled.
closed_decisions.COH-DEVICE-001: Client devices may become trusted by system_cooldown after configured cooldown, but only low_value_only; high-value remains back-office controlled.
closed_decisions.COH-ROLE-001: Managers never grant or remove mobile roles, including mobile_station_user; back-office grants all roles.
closed_decisions.COH-USER-001: Mobile users remain base.group_portal portal-type, but acpec_mobile_only requires password=false/no web credential and blocks portal web surfaces.

runtime_backend_patches.patch18A: block web password flows for mobile-only users
runtime_backend_patches.patch18B: block alternative web credentials for mobile-only users
runtime_backend_patches.patch18C: deny web sessions for mobile-only users
runtime_backend_patches.patch19A: approved mobile_state gate for sessions; signup stays pending
runtime_backend_patches.patch20A: device trust state and sensitive guard foundation
runtime_backend_patches.patch20B: apply trusted device gate to selected sensitive FuelToken actions
runtime_backend_patches.patch21A: server-side PIN required for selected sensitive actions

remaining_before_production: add strong request_hash idempotency where missing
add detailed business audit for sensitive actions
